summary: Iteration 22 testing completed. Backend APIs fully working (100% success). Contact form navigation bug from iteration21 confirmed and reproduced. FAQ SSR testing shows all routes working except missing JSON-LD schema. Locale dropdown not functioning.

resolved_from_iteration21.verification: Backend test shows notification_status returned correctly (value: 'gesendet')
Backend test confirms proper ID serialization, no '_id' or 'payload_hash' exposed
Backend test returns 200 with provider_event. Confirmed via MongoDB: provider_event='delivered' for recent emails

backend_issues.notes: Backend supervisor restart resolved all iteration21 issues. All 7 backend tests passing.

critical_bugs.issue: Form submission causes navigation with query parameters instead of JavaScript POST
critical_bugs.reproduction: Confirmed via browser automation. Form data appended to URL as GET request: /kontakt?name=...&email=...&message=...&consent=on
critical_bugs.impact: No API call made, no request created in database, success message never appears
critical_bugs.root_cause: Form submitting as HTML form (browser default GET) instead of using JavaScript onSubmit handler with event.preventDefault()
critical_bugs.fix_suggestion: Add action='' attribute to form element to prevent default HTML submission, or investigate why JavaScript handler not executing
critical_bugs.test_evidence: Browser test showed URL changed from /kontakt to /kontakt?name=...&email=... No network logs for /api/ requests captured. No database record created.

critical_bugs.issue: Locale dropdown changes value but page doesn't reload or update URL
critical_bugs.reproduction: Browser test on /leistungen/websites?lang=en. Selected 'de' from dropdown. Dropdown value changed to 'de' but URL stayed ?lang=en and content remained in English
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot switch languages via dropdown
critical_bugs.root_cause: window.location.assign() in onChange handler not executing or being prevented
critical_bugs.test_evidence: Browser test showed dropdown value changed from 'en' to 'de' but URL and page title unchanged

seo_issues.issue: JSON-LD FAQPage schema missing on all 10 FAQ routes
seo_issues.impact: Search engines cannot parse FAQ structured data for rich snippets
seo_issues.notes: HTML FAQ items present (8 items per page with data-testid='page-faq-item-{1-8}'). Only structured data missing.
